label: Anthropic (Claude)
help: Get an API key at platform.claude.com/settings/keys and set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

label: OpenAI
help: Get an API key at platform.openai.com/api-keys and set OPENAI_API_KEY. Current models require max_completion_tokens rather than max_tokens.

label: Moonshot AI (Kimi)
help: International endpoint. Get an API key at platform.moonshot.ai and set MOONSHOT_API_KEY.

label: Alibaba Cloud (Qwen)
help: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, OpenAI-compatible mode. This preset's endpoint is the Virginia (US) region. DashScope's other international regions are WORKSPACE-scoped (https://<WorkspaceId>.<region>.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 for Singapore / Hong Kong / Tokyo), so there is no single correct URL for every account — if yours differs, add it as a Custom OpenAI-compatible profile instead, which gets its own key slot. Get an API key at modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com and set DASHSCOPE_API_KEY.

label: Ollama (local)
help: Run `ollama serve` and pull a model first (e.g. `ollama pull qwen3`). No API key needed — the server only listens on localhost.

label: LM Studio (local)
help: Start the local server from LM Studio's Developer tab first. No API key needed — the server only listens on localhost.
